title: nbn 500/50 $50/Month for 6 Months (New Customers) @ amaysim
body:
Deal: nbn 500/50 $50/Month for 6 Months (New Customers) @ amaysim

[HD9990] buyers be aware terrible international routing even with gaming boosters/vpns, I used netease UU. still gets unstable connection/ slower than other ISPs
[El Grande] This. I was trying to find a deal to get back to Superloop. Internet Keeps getting worse and more unstable month by month. The first month was amazing. Now when I use VPN the speed drops down to a few Mbps which didn't happen before.
[VoidIvory] Superloop is still the best in Brisbane, at least. As far as I know, it is the only ISP that utilizes the Sunshine Coast landing point for JGA-S, which is critical for getting low ping to Asian areas.
[El Grande] I wouldn't jump to amaysim (Although I am currently with them). You get the advertised speeds but the data won't load if its coming from overseas servers. If you use VPN for overseas streaming apps then this provider is a no go.
[machej] Tangerine offer is better if you want quality over price.
[machej] Tangerine. Dodo only worth switching to with a very strong cashback offer. Dodo pays for reviews/does competitions to beef up their Product Review score so it's not accurate. (I received an SMS from them to leave a positive review for example)
[gamer9119] Is tangerine cheaper or same price as this?
[DealLlama67] Like others mentioned, horrible international routing, worst I've experienced in my years of churning ISPs.
Constantly getting less than 5mbps downloads when connecting to overseas servers.
Youtube videos also load very slowly when watching unpopular videos, which might be stored on overseas servers.
It's cheap but very unusable for my needs. Looking to switch out soon.
[Churna] I don’t get how amaysim has such bad international routing as it’s owned by Optus, an international company 😂😂

amaysim is the worst by far.
superloop i'm on 1000 plan but pointless so going back to $80/m on exetel, simple, no chasing up $20 off after 6 months then back to $9000/m or whatever
